get.description:
Areas inside `parent` with need, uncertainty, coverage and demand: its direct children,
or, with `level`, its descendants at that level. Every planner can read the national map
(parent=RW, level=district); sector detail is limited to the planner's own district.
Parents' centre requests per 500 m cell.
District aggregates. Counts below 5 are written as <5. Every row states its origin.
The nearest verified centres to a place, so a parent sees what exists before asking.
Sector boundaries of a district, so maps work without a basemap. Public data only.
Districts and their sectors with a central point, for the place picker.
